title: Document-to-JSON Converter
description: Enter a public PDF URL to extract structured data. Supports invoices, bank statements, contracts, and generic documents. Powered by DeepSeek-v4-flash AI.

file_url.title: PDF URL
file_url.description: Public URL of the PDF file to process (max 20MB). The PDF must be publicly accessible (e.g. Dropbox, Google Drive, web server).

document_type.title: Document Type
document_type.description: Type of document to extract. Each type has a different price and specific output format.

language.title: Document Language(s)
language.description: Languages for OCR and interpretation. Separate with + for multiple languages. ISO codes: ita, eng, spa, fra, deu, por.

validate_totals.title: Validate Totals (invoices only)
validate_totals.description: If enabled, checks that line item sums match declared totals. Useful for invoices. Discrepancies are reported as warnings.
